clue.text: Mark from wound, cut by one Bavarian with sword

indicators.note: the mark is cut open by the pieces that follow, which sit inside it

parts.note: a scar is the mark left by a wound
one is the Roman numeral I
mit is German, as spoken in Bavaria, for with

explanation.surface: A soldier is wounded and scarred by a Bavarian swordsman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bavarian' points to German, in which 'with' is MIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A scimitar is a curved oriental sabre, a kind of sword.

clue.text: Constant frost beginning to abate in peninsula

parts.note: C is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light
rime is hoar frost

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A constant frost that starts to ease over a peninsula: a weather report.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crimea is a peninsula jutting into the Black Sea.

clue.text: Phenomenal temperature found in a measurement at sea

indicators.note: the temperature letter is found inside the measurement

parts.note: a sounding is a measurement of water depth taken from a ship

explanation.surface: A sailor reports a remarkable temperature reading taken at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean amazingly impressive or extraordinary.

clue.text: Adult thought caused a smile

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult
to muse is to ponder, so mused means thought

explanation.surface: A grown-up's passing thought raised a grin.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that amused you entertained you enough to make you grin.

clue.text: Female's first victim seen in religion endlessly

indicators.note: the victim is seen inside the shortened religion
the word loses its final letter, its end

parts.note: Islam is a religion
in Genesis Abel, killed by Cain, is the first murder victim

explanation.surface: A woman was the first martyr of a faith, it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabella is a woman's given name, so a female as crosswords use names.

clue.text: Affected material finally deleted

indicators.note: the cloth's final letter is deleted

parts.note: tweed is a woollen fabric

explanation.surface: A tailor scraps a pretentious fabric at the last minute.
explanation.definitionFit: Twee means excessively dainty or quaint, an affected prettiness.

clue.text: Genuine support given for team of stars?

indicators.note: in a down answer the lower piece supports the one above, so this word goes beneath

parts.note: a side is a sports team
real means genuine

explanation.surface: Real backing given to a team full of star players.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidereal is the astronomical adjective meaning relating to the stars.

clue.text: Watched painfully having lost wife in divorce

indicators.note: the letters are twisted as if in pain, so they are rearranged
the wife's letter is lost from the pool before the reshuffle

explanation.surface: A man looked on in pain at a divorce, his wife gone.
explanation.walkthrough: Take W out of WATCHED and rearrange ATCHED.
explanation.definitionFit: To divorce two things is to separate or disconnect them.

clue.text: See 10
Song extolling tradition with Thatcherism is absurd

indicators.note: being absurd, the letters are thrown into a nonsensical new order

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at a song that pairs old customs with Thatcherite politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Irving Berlin's song dreams of a traditional snowy festive season.

clue.text: Snake has nothing for a voodoo priestess

indicators.note: the snake has one letter swapped, taking the new one
nothing stands for, replaces, the letter a

parts.note: the mamba is an African snake
nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A snake replaces a voodoo priestess with nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Mambo is the title of a priestess in Haitian vodou.

clue.text: Perhaps the lower classes use banger for cooking

indicators.note: cooking mixes ingredients, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: The working classes fry sausages for supper.
explanation.walkthrough: A banger is British slang for a sausage. 'Lower classes' suggests society; in biology a subgenus is a rank below the genus.
explanation.definitionFit: Subgenera are taxonomic ranks beneath genera, an example of lower classifications.

clue.text: Shown how rock and roller carries bucket down

indicators.note: the rock fan carries the downpour inside him

parts.note: a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s British rock and roll fan
to bucket down is to rain heavily

explanation.surface: A rocker carries a bucket downstairs.
explanation.walkthrough: Teddy boys were 1950s British youths in Edwardian-style suits devoted to rock and roll.
explanation.definitionFit: To be trained is to have been shown how to do something.

clue.text: Disturbance in East Berlin as DHL delivers Girl with the 21 Down 23

indicators.note: a disturbance throws the letters into disorder, rearranging them

explanation.surface: A parcel delivery in East Berlin stirs up trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads with 21 Down and 23 Down: Girl with the Dragon Tattoo, Stieg Larsson's novel. DHL is a parcel courier.
explanation.definitionFit: Lisbeth Salander is the hacker heroine of Larsson's Millennium novels.

clue.text: Where one occasionally lives in sin?

parts.note: read as wordplay, the answer gives second, abbreviated S, followed by home, meaning in, which together make the clue word

explanation.surface: Where somebody now and then cohabits unmarried.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lives in sin' reads as cohabiting, but split 'sin' into S (second) and IN (home, as in 'at home'): the answer, read as wordplay, makes the clue word.
explanation.definitionFit: A second home is a property used only part of the year besides one's main residence.

clue.text: Leader in congregation cuts talk short

indicators.note: the talk is cut, losing a letter, with short completing the signal
making a word short here removes its last letter

parts.note: rabbit is British slang for chatter, from rhyming slang rabbit and pork

explanation.surface: A minister trims his sermon to keep the flock happy.
explanation.walkthrough: Rabbit, meaning talk at length, is British rhyming slang (rabbit and pork, talk).
explanation.definitionFit: A rabbi is the religious leader of a Jewish congregation.

clue.text: Stop providing roof for a disreputable house?

indicators.note: in a down answer the top piece roofs what lies beneath it

parts.note: a bung is a stopper
low means base or disreputable

explanation.surface: Stop putting a roof on a house of ill repute.
explanation.definitionFit: A bungalow is a type of single-storey house, hence the question mark marking an example.

clue.text: Beginners in studio photographed as well

indicators.note: the beginners of words are their opening letters

explanation.surface: Newcomers at a studio got photographed too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as well' reads as 'too', but 'as' gives a letter and 'well' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A spa is a mineral spring, which is a kind of well.

clue.text: See 14
Cold beer initially bought spy in Canaan

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
ale is beer

indicators.note: initially means taking the first letter

explanation.surface: A spy is treated to a chilled beer in the Holy Land.
explanation.definitionFit: In Numbers, Caleb was one of the twelve men Moses sent to scout out Canaan.

clue.text: Bidders mad to accept European chicken feed?

indicators.note: the rearranged bidders accept the extra letter into their midst
the letters go mad, scrambled into a new order

explanation.surface: Frenzied bidders at auction take on a European offering that is a pittance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chicken feed' usually means a trifling sum; here it is literal food for birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Seed fed to birds, chickens among them, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Finished with girl in Irish county

parts.note: done means finished
gal is an informal word for girl

explanation.surface: Someone has wrapped things up with a girlfriend in Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Donegal is a county in the far northwest of Ireland.

clue.text: Inhale smoke from flame-thrower

definitions.meaning: to ... a cigarette is to inhale smoke from it, read as two words
a ... breathes fire, a flame-thrower of legend

explanation.walkthrough: Split into two words, the answer is the phrase for drawing on a cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical beast breathes fire, so it literally throws flames.

clue.text: Man's address to encompass New York cathedral?

indicators.note: the form of address goes round the extra letter

parts.note: Mister is how a man is addressed

explanation.surface: A man's speech reaching out to a cathedral in New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New York' reads as the American city, but 'New' gives N and York Minster is the famous cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: A minster is a large church; York's cathedral is called York Minster.

clue.text: Very small child receives letter from Greek

indicators.note: the child receives the Greek letter inside

parts.note: a mite is a small child
nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A tiny youngster gets a letter from Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Minute, stressed on the second syllable, means tiny.

clue.text: Needlework that's liberating husband as well

indicators.note: the husband is freed, set loose from the word

parts.note: the word that, with its apostrophe s acting as a link
too means as well

explanation.surface: Sewing that frees a husband from chores too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Needlework' suggests embroidery, but a tattoo is made with needles.
explanation.definitionFit: A tattoo is pricked into the skin with a needle, a jocular kind of needlework.

clue.text: Begin play about man eviscerated by a Greek hero

indicators.note: the starting call goes about, around, the gutted man

parts.note: game on is the call that play should start

indicators.note: eviscerated means with the insides removed, leaving the outer letters

explanation.surface: A Greek hero starts a contest with a disembowelled opponent.
explanation.definitionFit: Agamemnon led the Greek army against Troy in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: English brought to anger in country around Dublin?

parts.note: a three-letter literary word for wrath or fury

explanation.surface: An Englishman is angered in Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Éire is the Irish-language name of Ireland, whose capital is Dublin.

clue.text: Can't stand, as the drunk

indicators.note: a drunk staggers, so the letters reel into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone hates the drunkard, as one would.
explanation.definitionFit: If you cannot stand something, you loathe it.

clue.text: Frodo urgently concealing scent

indicators.note: the words conceal the answer inside them, across the gap

explanation.surface: The hobbit Frodo urgently covers his tracks from a scent.
explanation.definitionFit: An odour is a smell, as a scent is.

clue.text: Tons in river added to hold pressure without planning

indicators.note: the tons letter goes in the river

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon

indicators.note: the extra word holds the pressure letter inside

parts.note: more means additional, added
P is the symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Tons of water in a river add pressure, unplanned.
explanation.walkthrough: The Exe is a river in Devon, southwest England.
explanation.definitionFit: Extempore means spoken or done on the spur of the moment, unrehearsed.
